title: Supplementary code for: The Sphere Packing Problem in Dimension 4 and the Twenty-Four-Cell Conjecture
description: Scripts, certificates, run logs and Lean 4 verifications supporting the paper. The package contains the exact chamber certificates of the single-deviation bound, the covering bound at every contact count, the root-system meets and the 600-cell enumeration, the slack continuation, and the three-point semidefinite certificate for the twenty-three-contact case together with its verification in exact rational arithmetic, interval arithmetic and Lean 4. It also carries the two steps of the certificate of de Laat, Leijenhorst and de Muinck Keizer for the twenty-four-contact case that their own verification code leaves out, the construction of the zonal matrices and the four polynomial identities, recomputed here from their published data in exact rational arithmetic on an ordinary machine. Version v1.4.0 adds an independent re-verification of every computation of the paper, the distance criterion for neighbours that do not touch the centre (shell_reduction.py, in ball arithmetic) and a numerical search of the case it leaves open (shell_neighbour_search.py), with the corrections to the reduction from Voronoi cells to contact configurations that the re-verification found. The re-verification, those two programs and the corrections were developed with the assistance of Claude, an AI model made by Anthropic. Version v1.5.0 narrows the case left open by v1.4.0: a new section proves the bound whenever at most twenty-two centres lie within sqrt 6, whenever the contacts contain most of a root system, for most configurations of twenty-three contacts, and whenever no centre lies at a distance between 2 + epsilon_0 and sqrt 6 (so that the D4 configuration is a strict local minimum among all packings); its exact content is checked by closure_lemmas.py and again in Lean 4 by lean/D4Closure.lean. These were developed with the assistance of Claude, an AI model made by Anthropic.
